messages:
zoe: Quick capture from today's all-hands Q&A re: customer wins/losses. Summary: wins = clear migration playbooks, demo cost transparency, and repeatable pilot success. Losses = security/KMS friction, ambiguous latency expectations in demos, and a handful of domain-specific output regressions. Capture Qs + owners below.
harry: From GTM: prioritize fixes that unblock contract signatures (KMS + SLA clarity). We need a one-page migration runbook and a short SLA menu for AEs.
mai: Product ask: can CS/AE share 3 anonymized lost-deal notes? We want concrete language for the runbook and AE talking points.
oliver: Eng: short-term mitigations for regressions are a fallback stable model and better KV eviction telemetry. Small squad could ship a canary + dashboard in ~3 weeks. I can lead the canary.
sophie: CS will redact 3 lost deals and add "what was missing" + "what would have changed their mind" bullets. I'll also draft a migration checklist template with prerequisites, test plan, and rollback steps.
zoe: Leadership Qs: who owns (A) SLA menu & legal loop, (B) migration runbook + AE card, (C) fallback canary + KV metrics? Please @ owners so we can track.
harry: I'll own (A) and loop in legal/security.
mai: I'll own (B) with Sophie helping. Comms can help with external wording.
oliver: Confirming (C) for Eng. Need eval prompts for the regression cases from product by Wed.
sophie: I'll post the redacted lost-deal notes by EOD tomorrow and the first draft of the checklist by Friday.
ops-bot: Created ticket RW-5020 in infra/serving: "All-hands follow-up - SLA menu + runbook + fallback canary" assigned to harry,mai,oliver; linked to thread 2356789012.
zoe: Action recap: harry (SLA + legal), mai/sophie (runbook + AE card), oliver (canary + metrics), zoe (compile evals + shared doc). Proposed 25m sync Friday 10am. React with :thumbsup: to confirm or suggest another time.
